Congress Leaders Criticize PM Modi's Silence on Manipur

Congress leaders Jairam Ramesh and Pawan Khera have criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi, using the phrase 'Kab tak chappan' which translates to 'How long will you hide?'. This remark is directed at the Prime Minister's perceived silence on the ongoing violence in Manipur. The Congress party is using this phrase to question the government's response and the Prime Minister's engagement with the issue.
